content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Akron

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and documented project-management experience. Review PMI's specific thresholds for your background—whether you hold a bachelor's degree, associate degree, or high school diploma shapes your experience requirement. Gather project documentation to verify your hours before applying.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Certification Training course. Attend sessions from your location on a schedule that fits your professional commitments. Our active certified practitioners guide you through the PMBOK® Guide, exam domains, and real-world scenarios—all online, no travel required.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing the 35 contact hours, submit your formal PMP application to PMI. Include your training certificate from Granite PM Academy, project experience records, and required fees. PMI reviews and either approves or requests additional documentation before exam eligibility.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice tests, study guides, and instructor Q&A—to solidify your readiness. Schedule your exam through PMI's testing partner. Pass the computerized exam to earn your PMP credential, recognized across Advanced Manufacturing, Healthcare, Insurance, Engineering, Logistics, and Higher Education sectors in Akron.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: PMP certification renews every three years. Earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) through training, conferences, volunteer work, or authorship. Plan your PDU strategy early, and stay current with PMI requirements to keep your credential active and your career competitive.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.
